tldr: 台股單日狂飆寫下史上第5大漲點，受AMD投資台灣與AI題材帶動，加權指數叩關42,000點。
AMD執行長蘇姿丰宣布逾百億美元投資台灣晶片供應鏈，擴建AI基礎設施先進封裝產能。
全球長債殖利率飆升、美30年期破5%，伊朗戰事油價與政府債務惡化重燃停滯性通膨與債務危機疑慮。
美伊停火露曙光帶動美股走高，道瓊收盤改寫近三個月新高。
台灣金融監理收緊：金管會核定國外成分ETF期貨三階段漲跌幅，並推動IFRS永續揭露工作坊。

items.title_zh: 台股飆漲改寫史上第5大漲點
items.title_en: Taiwan stocks notch 5th-largest point gain on record
items.summary_zh: 台股單日大漲，漲點寫下台股史上第5大紀錄，加權指數叩關42,000點。盤面氣氛受AMD百億美元投資台灣、AI需求續強及美股走高激勵；記憶體廠南亞科同步調升資本支出，反映DRAM市況吃緊。主管機關另確認國外成分證券ETF期貨將採三階段漲跌幅熔斷機制。這波漲勢凸顯資金高度集中於AI題材，後續指數能否續攻成為市場關注焦點。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's TAIEX rocketed in a session that ranked as the island's fifth-biggest single-day point gain ever, with the benchmark pushing toward the 42,000 level. Sentiment was supercharged by AMD's multibillion-dollar Taiwan investment pledge, resilient AI demand and a firmer Wall Street. Memory maker Nanya Technology added fuel by raising its capital-expenditure plan amid a tight DRAM market. Regulators separately confirmed new three-stage circuit-breaker limits for foreign-asset ETF futures. The rally underscores how concentrated AI-driven optimism has become and raises questions over how much further the index can run.

items.title_zh: 台日韓股市同步噴出
items.title_en: Taiwan, Japan and Korea equities rally in tandem
items.summary_zh: 亞股迎來強勢一日，台股、日股與韓股同步走高，背後是與美股相同的AI投資熱潮與地緣風險降溫題材帶動。三地齊揚反映北亞市場與全球半導體、AI硬體景氣循環高度連動，晶片權值股領漲。對投資人而言，區域同步走強代表風險胃納回升；但也意味指數表現集中在少數科技股，一旦AI資本支出題材生變，回檔風險不小。
items.summary_en: Asian markets enjoyed a strong session as Taiwanese, Japanese and South Korean benchmarks climbed together, riding the same AI-investment and easing-geopolitical-risk themes that lifted US stocks overnight. The synchronized advance reflects how heavily North Asian markets are tied to the global semiconductor and AI hardware cycle, with chip-related heavyweights leading gains. For investors, the broad regional strength signals risk appetite is returning, though it also concentrates index performance in a narrow set of technology names vulnerable to any shift in AI capex sentiment.

items.title_zh: 中工經營權變天 寶佳入主
items.title_en: Pao Chia group seizes control of China Engineering
items.summary_zh: 營建開發集團中工（中華工程）經營權易主，由寶佳陣營取得主導權，鄭斯聰、馮敦承分別出任董事長與總經理。此一董事會改組為市場關注已久的經營權之爭畫下句點，重塑這家大型上市營建商的領導班子，也顯示台灣營建集團整併動作持續。後續公司營運策略、推案計畫與財務布局走向，以及對小股東權益的影響，成為關注重點。
items.summary_en: A boardroom shakeup handed control of construction-and-development group BES Engineering ("中工") to the Pao Chia camp, with Cheng Szu-tsung and Feng Tun-cheng installed as chairman and president. The change marks the resolution of a closely watched management-rights contest in Taiwan's property and infrastructure sector. The outcome reshapes the leadership of a major listed developer and signals continued consolidation activity among Taiwan's construction conglomerates, with implications for the firm's project pipeline, balance-sheet strategy and minority shareholders.

items.title_zh: 外資點名環球晶等4檔半導體尖兵
items.title_en: Foreign brokers spotlight four chip-material "front-line" stocks
items.summary_zh: 隨著新世代半導體製造技術成形，外資研究報告點名矽晶圓廠環球晶等4家供應商，視為迎接晶片大革命的「最前線」受惠族群。此看法把投資焦點導向支援先進封裝與AI晶片生產的上游材料、設備廠，而非僅聚焦晶圓代工權值股，顯示AI投資題材正沿供應鏈擴散。不過，這類點名式推薦也可能放大相關個股的短線波動。
items.summary_en: As a wave of next-generation semiconductor manufacturing technology takes shape, foreign institutional research has flagged silicon-wafer maker GlobalWafers and three other suppliers as key beneficiaries positioned at the "front line" of the coming chip revolution. The call directs investor attention toward upstream materials and equipment names that support advanced packaging and AI-chip production, rather than just headline foundry stocks. It reflects a broadening of the AI-investment narrative down the supply chain, though such targeted recommendations can amplify short-term volatility in the named stocks.

items.title_zh: AMD宣布逾百億美元投資台灣供應鏈
items.title_en: AMD pledges over US$10bn to Taiwan's chip ecosystem
items.summary_zh: AMD執行長蘇姿丰訪台，宣布投資逾100億美元布局台灣半導體供應鏈，攜手日月光、矽品、力成、欣興、Sanmina、緯穎、緯創、英業達等封測、載板與系統廠。資金將擴大先進封裝產能，支持2.5D橋接互連與面板級技術研發，並推動AMD Helios機架級AI平台於2026年下半年部署。此舉深化AMD對台灣製造基地的倚賴，也加大其在AI基礎設施市場對輝達的挑戰力道。
items.summary_en: AMD CEO Lisa Su, visiting Taiwan, announced an investment exceeding US$10 billion across the island's semiconductor supply chain, partnering with packaging, substrate and system makers including ASE, SPIL, Powertech, Unimicron, Sanmina, Wiwynn, Wistron and Inventec. The funds will expand advanced-packaging capacity, support 2.5D bridge-interconnect and panel-level technology R&D, and enable rack-scale deployment of AMD's Helios AI platform in late 2026. The commitment deepens AMD's reliance on Taiwan's manufacturing base and intensifies its challenge to Nvidia in the AI-infrastructure race.

items.title_zh: 南亞科擴廠 DRAM喊缺到2027年底
items.title_en: Nanya Technology expands as DRAM shortage seen lasting into 2027
items.summary_zh: 記憶體廠南亞科啟動擴廠，業界預估DRAM供給短缺將延續到2027年底，公司並鎖定支撐AI加速器的超高頻寬記憶體（HBM）市場。記憶體供給吃緊加上AI需求強勁，墊高DRAM廠的報價能力；南亞科加碼資本支出，釋出對這波記憶體上行循環仍將延續的信心。此擴產動向牽動台灣記憶體產業、AI伺服器組裝廠，以及面臨零組件成本上揚的下游客戶。
items.summary_en: Memory maker Nanya Technology is moving to expand fab capacity, with industry forecasts pointing to a DRAM supply shortage stretching to the end of 2027. The company is also targeting the high-bandwidth memory market that underpins AI accelerators. Tight memory supply and AI-driven demand have lifted pricing power for DRAM suppliers, and Nanya's capex increase signals confidence the upcycle has further to run. The expansion matters for Taiwan's memory sector, AI server builders and downstream customers facing rising component costs.

items.title_zh: AI熱潮帶動PCB與銅箔基板
items.title_en: AI boom powers PCB and copper-clad-laminate makers
items.summary_zh: AI需求暢旺帶動台灣印刷電路板（PCB）供應鏈強勁成長，其中PCB核心材料銅箔基板（CCL）表現亮眼，相關個股今年以來一路走高。AI伺服器需要更多層數、更高規格的板材，同時推升出貨量與報價。報導探討CCL這波上行循環還能熱多久，這既是擠進AI周邊概念股投資人關注的重點，也牽動下游板廠的產能與材料成本調度。
items.summary_en: Strong AI demand is driving robust growth across Taiwan's printed circuit board (PCB) supply chain, with copper-clad laminate (CCL) — a core PCB material — among the standout performers, its related stocks rallying through the year so far. AI servers require more layers and higher-spec boards, lifting both volumes and pricing. The report weighs how much longer the CCL upcycle can last, a key question for investors crowded into AI-adjacent names and for downstream board makers managing capacity and material costs.

items.title_zh: SpaceX奪AI大單 台廠伺服器供應鏈沾光
items.title_en: SpaceX AI order seen sparking server build-out, lifting Taiwan supply chain
items.summary_zh: 市場傳出SpaceX拿下AI相關大單，預期將帶動新一波伺服器建置潮，台灣硬體供應鏈可望受惠。台廠在AI伺服器組裝與零組件供應居關鍵地位，新增的超大規模運算需求會迅速反映到本地業者訂單。此發展強化「AI基礎設施投資正從傳統雲端巨頭擴散到新進業者」的題材，即使估值偏高，仍為台灣電子製造業者撐起訂單能見度。
items.summary_en: SpaceX has reportedly secured a major AI-related contract expected to trigger a fresh wave of server construction, positioning Taiwan's hardware supply chain to benefit. Taiwanese ODMs and component makers dominate AI server assembly, so incremental hyperscale-style demand flows quickly to local firms. The development reinforces the theme that AI-infrastructure spending is broadening beyond the traditional cloud giants to new entrants, supporting order visibility for Taiwan's electronics manufacturers even as valuations stretch.

items.title_zh: 黃仁勳稱華為「非常強大」 坦言讓出中國AI晶片市場
items.title_en: Nvidia's Huang calls Huawei "very strong," concedes China AI-chip ground
items.summary_zh: 輝達執行長黃仁勳形容華為是「非常強大」的對手，並坦言美國出口管制實質上把中國AI晶片市場大半讓給本土業者，華為主導的時代正在成形。此番話凸顯美方原欲遏制中國的限制措施，反而加速中國打造自主AI硬體生態系。對輝達而言意味在龐大市場流失營收；對台灣晶片供應鏈來說，則使長期中國曝險與技術標準分流的隱憂更受關注。
items.summary_en: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang described Huawei as a "very strong" competitor and acknowledged that US export curbs have effectively ceded much of China's AI-chip market to domestic players, with a Huawei-led era taking shape. The remarks underline how Washington's restrictions, intended to slow China, are accelerating a self-sufficient Chinese AI hardware ecosystem. For Nvidia, it means lost revenue in a huge market; for Taiwan's chip supply chain, it sharpens questions about long-term China exposure and bifurcating technology standards.

items.title_zh: 3名台人涉走私輝達AI伺服器赴中
items.title_en: Three Taiwanese accused of smuggling Nvidia AI servers to China
items.summary_zh: 3名台灣籍人士涉嫌違反美國出口管制「紅線」，將輝達高階AI伺服器走私輸往中國，經濟部就此提出三點聲明說明立場。此案凸顯受管制先進運算硬體的執法風險，以及台灣在防堵轉口管道上承受的壓力。對台灣科技業而言，這牽動商譽與法遵風險——必須證明能防止自身供應鏈成為美國管制措施的破口。
items.summary_en: Three Taiwanese nationals are alleged to have smuggled high-end Nvidia AI servers into China in breach of US export-control "red lines," prompting Taiwan's Ministry of Economic Affairs to issue a three-point statement clarifying its position. The case highlights the enforcement risk surrounding restricted advanced computing hardware and the pressure on Taiwan to police re-export channels. It carries reputational and compliance stakes for Taiwan's tech sector, which must show it can prevent its supply chain from becoming a loophole in US controls.

items.title_zh: 金管會推資源協助企業接軌IFRS永續揭露準則
items.title_en: FSC rolls out resources to help firms adopt IFRS sustainability disclosure
items.summary_zh: 金管會公布多項支援措施與工作坊，協助上市櫃公司接軌IFRS永續揭露準則。接軌採分階段、依實收資本額推進：資本額100億元以上者已自2026年適用，50至100億元者2027年跟進。金管會自5月起辦4場IFRS S2實作工作坊，7至8月辦6場溫室氣體盤查工作坊，並編製IFRS S1指引。此舉旨在提升資訊透明度與企業永續競爭力，也墊高上市櫃公司的法遵門檻。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's Financial Supervisory Commission unveiled support measures and workshops to help listed companies adopt the IFRS sustainability disclosure standards. Adoption is phased by paid-in capital: firms above NT$10bn began in 2026, those with NT$5-10bn follow in 2027. The FSC is running four IFRS S2 practical workshops from May and six greenhouse-gas inventory workshops in July-August, plus an IFRS S1 guide. The push aims to lift disclosure transparency and sustainability competitiveness, raising the compliance bar for Taiwan's listed issuers.

items.title_zh: 金管會核定國外成分ETF期貨採三階段漲跌幅
items.title_en: FSC adopts three-stage price limits for foreign-asset ETF futures
items.summary_zh: 金管會督導期交所，將現行國外成分證券ETF期貨及選擇權單一±15%漲跌幅，自2026年7月6日起改採三階段機制：債券類採±5%、±10%、±15%，股權類採±7%、±10%、±15%；觸及前兩階段時進入5分鐘冷卻期再放寬。由於國外成分ETF本身無漲跌幅限制，且期貨開盤早於現貨，新熔斷設計可在海外重大事件引發劇烈波動時強化風險控管，期貨交易人須留意交易機制調整。
items.summary_en: The FSC, overseeing the Taiwan Futures Exchange, will replace the current single ±15% daily limit on futures and options tracking foreign-asset ETFs with a three-stage mechanism from 6 July 2026. Bond-type ETF derivatives will use ±5%/±10%/±15% bands; equity-type will use ±7%/±10%/±15%. Hitting the first two stages triggers a five-minute cooling period before limits widen. Because foreign-asset ETFs have no inherent price ceilings and futures open before the cash market, the new circuit-breaker design strengthens risk control against extreme volatility around overseas events.

items.title_zh: 五大銀行新承做房貸大減 房市續軟著陸
items.title_en: Five major banks' new mortgage lending slides as housing market cools
items.summary_zh: 受房市軟著陸影響，五大銀行4月新承做房貸金額降至533.36億元，月減56.88億元，創近七個月次低。六都建物買賣移轉棟數月減14.21%、年減7.06%；新承做房貸利率2.307%，新青安房貸占比達42.91%。數據顯示央行推動房市軟著陸的策略正同步壓抑交易量與房價漲勢。此趨勢牽動銀行放款動能、建商推案，以及有購屋與新青安申貸需求的民眾。
items.summary_en: New mortgage lending by Taiwan's five major banks fell to NT$53.34bn in April, down NT$5.69bn on the month and the second-lowest in seven months, as the property market continues a managed slowdown. Transaction volumes in the six special municipalities dropped 14.21% month-on-month and 7.06% year-on-year; the new mortgage rate stood at 2.307%, with the subsidized "new youth housing" loan making up 42.91%. The data confirm the central bank's soft-landing strategy is curbing both volumes and price pressure, affecting banks, developers and homebuyers.

items.title_zh: 永豐金證券升級「大戶投」APP 整合三大下單服務
items.title_en: SinoPac Securities revamps "DawHo" app to integrate three trading services
items.summary_zh: 永豐金證券升級「大戶投」交易APP，將三大下單服務整合於單一介面，訴求讓投資人免於切換平台或遭遇服務「停擺」的困擾。此舉反映台灣券商競相以更流暢的數位體驗爭奪散戶下單流量，尤其在台股多頭、散戶參與創高之際更顯關鍵。APP整合度正成為券商在便利性與穩定度上競爭的差異化要素，而不再只是比拚手續費高低。
items.summary_en: SinoPac Securities has upgraded its "DawHo" (大戶投) trading app to integrate three core order-placement services into one interface, aiming to spare investors the disruption of switching platforms or facing service "outages." The move reflects intensifying competition among Taiwanese brokerages to win retail order flow through smoother digital experiences, especially as a buoyant stock market draws record retail participation. App integration is increasingly a differentiator for brokers competing on convenience and reliability rather than purely on fees.

items.title_zh: 五張「百億神單」投資型保單 寫業界紀錄
items.title_en: Five "NT$10bn blockbuster" investment-linked policies set an industry record
items.summary_zh: 台灣壽險業今年前四月賣出五張新契約保費各破百億元的投資型保單，合計逾1,160億元，其中國泰人壽獨拿三張、安聯與元大人壽各一張。前四月壽險業總保費達1兆495億元、年增21.1%，新契約保費年增更高達42.3%。這波熱賣顯示在台股多頭下，投資型保單已成民眾參與股市與理財的重要工具，重塑壽險公司、銀行保險通路與財富管理銷售端的商品結構，下半年買氣可望延燒。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's life insurers sold five investment-linked policies that each topped NT$10bn in new premiums in the first four months of 2026, together generating over NT$116bn — Cathay Life alone produced three, with Allianz and Yuanta Life one each. Total life-insurance premiums reached NT$1.0495 trillion for the period, up 21.1% year-on-year, while first-year premiums surged 42.3%. The boom shows investment-linked policies have become a key vehicle for households to ride Taiwan's bull market, reshaping product mix for insurers, bancassurance channels and wealth-management distributors.

items.title_zh: 安聯00402A美國科技主動式ETF 5/22起募集
items.title_en: Allianz launches "00402A" active US-tech ETF, subscription opens 22 May
items.summary_zh: 安聯投信推出第三檔主動式ETF「00402A安聯美國科技領航主動式ETF」，採「3Q+」策略，聚焦美國科技領航產業，涵蓋高端半導體、AI應用與消費電子。募集期為2026年5月22日至27日，每單位發行價10元，預計6月上旬掛牌。基金結合海外與台灣投研團隊，讓投資人直接參與美國科技創新核心，跳脫台股供應鏈框架，主要鎖定看好AI、半導體結構性成長的投資人，也反映主動式ETF商品線持續擴張。
items.summary_en: Allianz Global Investors Taiwan rolled out its third actively managed ETF, the "00402A Allianz US Tech Pilot Active ETF," which uses a "3Q+" strategy to focus on US technology leaders spanning advanced semiconductors, AI applications and consumer electronics. The subscription period runs 22-27 May 2026 at NT$10 per unit, with listing expected in early June. Combining overseas and Taiwan research teams, the fund lets investors access US tech innovation directly rather than via the Taiwan supply chain — targeting clients seeking structural AI and semiconductor growth.

items.title_zh: 2026報稅季：執業者當心五大申報錯誤
items.title_en: 2026 tax season: practitioners warned of five common income-reporting errors
items.summary_zh: 財政部高雄國稅局提醒醫師、律師、會計師等申報「執行業務所得」的執業者，2026年報稅時應避免五大常見錯誤，包括漏報扣繳憑單收入、漏報補助款等。在綜所稅申報季開跑之際，此一提醒旨在降低因不慎短漏報而遭補稅、處罰的風險。對自營專業人士而言，這是申報前務必逐項勾稽各類所得來源的實務提醒。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's Kaohsiung National Taxation Bureau reminded professional practitioners — such as doctors, lawyers and accountants filing "practice income" — to avoid five frequent mistakes when filing 2026 returns, including omitting withholding-statement income and government subsidies. With the individual income-tax filing season underway, the guidance aims to reduce back-tax assessments and penalties from inadvertent under-reporting. It is a practical reminder for self-employed professionals to reconcile all income sources before submission.

items.title_zh: 中小企業轉型升級 政府擬給予租稅優惠
items.title_en: Government weighs tax breaks for SME transformation and upgrading
items.summary_zh: 政府研擬以租稅優惠鼓勵中小企業轉型升級，相關誘因可望支持中小企業投入現代化升級，可能涵蓋數位、AI或永續相關投資，目的在協助體質較小的企業在技術快速變遷下維持競爭力。若拍板，將降低這群占台灣就業人口大宗的企業在資本投資上的實質稅負成本。不過，適用範圍與合格支出認定等細節仍待定案。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's authorities are considering preferential tax treatment to encourage small and medium-sized enterprises to transform and upgrade. The proposed incentives would support SMEs investing in modernization — potentially covering digital, AI or sustainability-related upgrades — as policymakers seek to keep smaller firms competitive amid rapid technological change. If enacted, the measure would lower the effective tax cost of capital investment for a segment that employs the bulk of Taiwan's workforce, though details on scope and qualifying spending remain to be finalized.

items.title_zh: 工廠停工 房屋稅仍可減半徵收
items.title_en: Idled factories can still claim a 50% house-tax cut
items.summary_zh: 稅務機關說明，工廠廠房即使停工，只要符合相關條件，仍可適用房屋稅減半徵收的優惠。此一提醒有助於面臨暫時性停工的製造業者——無論是因需求疲弱、營運重整或外部衝擊——在閒置期間避免溢繳房屋稅。對在製造業部分次產業景氣轉弱之際、須控管持有成本的工業不動產所有權人而言，是一項實用的稅務釐清。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's tax authorities clarified that factory buildings remain eligible for a 50% reduction in house tax even when operations are suspended, provided the relevant conditions are met. The reminder helps manufacturers facing temporary shutdowns — whether from weak demand, restructuring or external shocks — avoid overpaying property tax during idle periods. It is a useful clarification for industrial-property owners managing holding costs through a softer patch in parts of the manufacturing sector.

items.title_zh: 電影演唱會球賽免娛樂稅 北市籲回饋消費者
items.title_en: Taipei urges venues to pass on amusement-tax exemption to consumers
items.summary_zh: 台北市稅捐處指出，電影、演唱會與球賽享有娛樂稅免稅優惠，並呼籲業者將省下的稅負回饋給消費者，而非自行留用。此一呼籲回應外界疑慮——原為支持文化與體育活動的免稅優惠，不見得反映在較低的票價上。這也讓娛樂產業的訂價透明度受到關注，提醒業者免稅政策的目標在於擴大民眾參與及消費者受益。
items.summary_en: The Taipei City Revenue Service highlighted that films, concerts and ball games enjoy an amusement-tax exemption, and called on operators to pass the resulting savings on to consumers rather than retaining them. The appeal addresses concerns that tax relief intended to support cultural and sporting activity does not always translate into lower ticket prices. It puts a spotlight on pricing transparency in entertainment, reminding businesses that the exemption's policy goal is wider public access and consumer benefit.

items.title_zh: 美關稅退款逼近1490億美元 川普揚言改課
items.title_en: Tariff refunds near US$149bn as Trump vows alternative levies
items.summary_zh: 與美國關稅相關的退款金額逼近1,490億美元，據報導令川普總統震怒，揚言將以「其他方式」重新課稅、把稅收追回。此一情況源於現行關稅措施面臨法律與程序挑戰，而替代性課稅的可能性，為美國貿易政策再添不確定性。對出口商、跨國企業與市場而言，這意味美國保護主義壓力難以鬆動，關稅的形式（即使非規模）恐將持續變動。
items.summary_en: Refunds tied to US tariffs are approaching US$149 billion, a development that reportedly angered President Trump, who pledged to recoup the revenue by imposing taxes through "other methods." The situation stems from legal and procedural challenges to existing tariff measures, and the prospect of replacement levies injects fresh uncertainty into US trade policy. For exporters, multinationals and markets, it signals that US protectionist pressure is unlikely to ease and that the form — if not the scale — of tariffs could keep shifting.

items.title_zh: 台灣成立院級「國家AI戰略特別委員會」
items.title_en: Taiwan sets up cabinet-level National AI Strategy Committee
items.summary_zh: 依據今年1月施行的《人工智慧基本法》，台灣成立院級「國家人工智慧戰略特別委員會」，由行政院長卓榮泰擔任召集人，國科會主委任執行秘書，委員涵蓋中央部會首長、地方首長與民間代表。任務包括7月底前完成公務機關AI風險評估、研訂台灣首部「國家人工智慧發展綱領」，以及建立分為應用、開發、研究三類的AI人才認定指引。此舉象徵政府以由上而下方式統籌跨政府、產業與教育的AI政策。
items.summary_en: Under the AI Basic Act that took effect in January, Taiwan has established a cabinet-level "National AI Strategy Special Committee," convened by Premier Cho Jung-tai with the National Science and Technology Council minister as executive secretary. Members span central ministers, local government heads and private-sector representatives. Tasks include completing an AI risk assessment for public agencies by end-July, drafting Taiwan's first national AI development guidelines, and creating an AI-talent classification framework. The body signals a centralized, top-down push to coordinate AI policy across government, industry and education.

items.title_zh: 電力景氣燈號連12個月亮紅燈
items.title_en: Power-demand indicator flashes "red" for 12th straight month
items.summary_zh: 台灣綜合研究院公布4月電力景氣燈號續亮紅燈，已連續12個月維持代表景氣擴張的紅燈。全國高壓以上產業用電量年增3.27%，其中半導體業用電年增14.03%；製造業外銷訂單年增48.1%、電子產品外銷訂單年增45.9%，印證台灣經濟在AI驅動下動能強勁。但景氣冷熱不均——化學材料、鋼鐵、紡織等傳產因中東戰事推升成本而承壓，凸顯科技業與傳產的差距持續擴大。
items.summary_en: The Taiwan Research Institute's electricity-business indicator stayed at "red" in April, marking 12 consecutive months of expansion-signaling readings. Industrial electricity use among high-voltage users rose 3.27% year-on-year, with semiconductor consumption up 14.03%; manufacturing export orders jumped 48.1% and electronics export orders 45.9%. The data confirm AI-driven momentum in Taiwan's economy. But the picture is uneven — chemicals, steel and textiles face pressure from higher costs linked to Middle East conflict, underscoring a widening gap between tech and traditional industries.

items.title_zh: 川普延後簽署AI行政命令 力保領先中國優勢
items.title_en: Trump delays AI executive order to safeguard lead over China
items.summary_zh: 川普總統延後簽署原訂的AI行政命令，外界解讀此一延遲是為確保政策能穩固美國對中國的技術領先優勢。暫緩動作顯示美國政府正重新校準AI發展、出口與安全相關措施，以極大化競爭優勢。對晶片廠、雲端業者及包括台灣在內的美國盟友而言，這道命令的時程與最終內容將牽動出口規範與投資誘因，使AI政策對全球科技供應鏈而言仍是變動中的目標。
items.summary_en: President Trump has postponed signing a planned AI executive order, with the delay framed as an effort to ensure the policy firmly preserves America's technological lead over China. The pause suggests the administration is recalibrating measures on AI development, export and security to maximize competitive advantage. For chipmakers, cloud providers and US allies including Taiwan, the timing and final content of the order will shape export rules and investment incentives, keeping AI policy a moving target for the global technology supply chain.

items.title_zh: 美伊停火露曙光 道瓊收盤改寫新高
items.title_en: Dow closes at record as US-Iran ceasefire hopes lift Wall Street
items.summary_zh: 美股尾盤拉升，道瓊工業指數收盤改寫新高，為近三個月來首見，主因美伊可能達成停火的跡象使地緣風險降溫。這波漲勢反映市場對油價供給衝擊可望避免感到寬慰，同時AI相關股仍受熱捧。盤勢顯示市場對中東消息面仍高度敏感；漲勢能否延續，取決於停火架構能否守住，而非在後續談判中生變。
items.summary_en: US stocks rallied late in the session and the Dow Jones Industrial Average closed at a record high — its first in three months — as signs of a possible US-Iran ceasefire eased geopolitical risk. The advance reflected relief that an oil-supply shock could be averted, alongside continued enthusiasm for AI-related shares. The move shows how sensitive markets remain to Middle East headlines; a durable rally would depend on the ceasefire framework holding rather than unraveling in subsequent negotiations.

items.title_zh: 長債殖利率狂飆 重燃全球債務危機疑慮
items.title_en: Surging long-bond yields revive global debt-crisis fears
items.summary_zh: 全球長天期公債殖利率大幅上揚：美國30年期殖利率突破5%、創2007年以來新高，英、日殖利率也升抵近30年高點。伊朗戰事推升油價、政府財政惡化、央行政策轉向與AI帶來的通膨壓力，迫使市場重新評估利率，並引發停滯性通膨疑慮；全球政府債務占GDP比重預估將突破100%。殖利率走高墊高房貸、車貸與企業借貸成本，壓縮家庭與企業支出，也使各國政府利息支出快速膨脹。
items.summary_en: Long-dated government bond yields are climbing sharply worldwide: the US 30-year yield has topped 5%, its highest since 2007, while UK and Japanese yields hit roughly 30-year highs. Iran-related oil pressure, deteriorating public finances, shifting central-bank policy and AI-driven inflation are forcing markets to reprice rates, raising stagflation concerns. Global government debt is projected to exceed 100% of GDP. Higher yields lift mortgage, auto and corporate borrowing costs, squeezing households and firms — and swelling governments' own interest bills.

items.title_zh: 油價劇烈震盪：飆漲4%後逆轉收挫
items.title_en: Oil swings: crude spikes 4% then reverses as Iran talks add uncertainty
items.summary_zh: 國際油價劇烈震盪，盤中一度飆漲約4%，隨後逆轉收低，主因美伊談判消息快速變化擾動能源市場；布蘭特原油跌破103美元，創近兩週低點。這種波動顯示交易員難以拿捏中東情勢降溫與升溫（恐衝擊供給）的機率。對台灣等進口國而言，油價若持續回落有助緩解通膨與投入成本壓力；但盤中大幅來回擺盪，顯示地緣政治風險溢價仍極不穩定。
items.summary_en: Oil prices whipsawed, jumping about 4% before reversing to close lower, as fast-moving US-Iran negotiation headlines unsettled the energy market; Brent crude fell below US$103 to a near-two-week low. The volatility shows traders struggling to price the probability of a Middle East de-escalation versus an escalation that could disrupt supply. For importers like Taiwan, a sustained pullback would ease inflation and input-cost pressure, but the wide intraday swings signal the geopolitical risk premium remains highly unstable.

items.title_zh: 川普施壓伊朗交出濃縮鈾庫存
items.title_en: Trump presses Iran to surrender enriched uranium amid ceasefire push
items.summary_zh: 川普總統再度要求伊朗交出濃縮鈾庫存，並暗示取得後可能予以銷毀，這項要求是美伊停火外交的核心爭點。此一強硬條件凸顯任何協議仍相當脆弱——據傳德黑蘭不願將庫存運出國外，恐使協議破局。由於這場談判正牽動全球油價與股市的起伏，這個特定僵局的結果，對全球風險環境具有超乎比例的影響力。
items.summary_en: President Trump has again pressed Iran to hand over its enriched-uranium stockpile, suggesting the material could be destroyed once obtained — a demand at the center of US-Iran ceasefire diplomacy. The hardline condition underscores how fragile any agreement remains, since Tehran's reported reluctance to ship stockpiles abroad could derail a deal. Because the negotiations are driving oil-price and equity-market swings worldwide, the outcome of this specific sticking point carries outsized weight for the global risk environment.

items.title_zh: SpaceX傳籌備史上最大IPO 估值上看1.75兆美元
items.title_en: SpaceX eyes record IPO with valuation seen up to US$1.75tn
items.summary_zh: SpaceX傳出正籌備可能成為史上規模最大的首次公開發行（IPO），估值據引述高達1.75兆美元，報導聚焦散戶如何在這檔市場高度期待的新股掛牌首日「上車」。如此規模的掛牌將是私人企業市場的里程碑，也是對投資人承接超大型科技股胃納的重大考驗。考量SpaceX傳有AI相關訂單，這樁IPO與AI基礎設施題材相互交織，影響層面遠超航太產業。
items.summary_en: SpaceX is reportedly preparing what could become the largest IPO in history, with its valuation cited as high as US$1.75 trillion. Coverage focuses on how retail investors might gain first-day access to the heavily anticipated offering. A listing of this scale would be a landmark for private-company markets and a major test of investor appetite for mega-cap technology. It also intersects with the AI-infrastructure theme, given SpaceX's reported AI-related contracts, making the deal relevant well beyond the aerospace sector.
